extracted.name: Pineapple Cleanser Smoothie
extracted.description: This vibrant cucumber and pineapple smoothie with celery, ginger, parsley, lemon, and coconut water is a very refreshing way to start the day!
ingredient_lines: 1 cup coconut water, or to taste
instruction_lines: Blend coconut water, pineapple, celery, cucumber, lemon, parsley, and ginger together in a blender until smooth.
